data.name: Agyaat
data.detailed_description:
🕯️ About This Game

In Agyaat, you step into the shoes of Acharya, a scholar whose quest for truth leads him deep into the decaying corridors of Ambika’s House — an ancient mansion whispered to be cursed. What begins as a search for knowledge quickly becomes a descent into fear, isolation, and the supernatural.

Each shadow hides a secret, each whisper tells a story, and each door you open draws you closer to a truth that was never meant to be found. The boundaries between the spiritual and the living blur as you uncover fragments of a forgotten ritual — one that binds souls to the house for eternity.

You are not alone in Ambika’s home. Something watches. Something remembers.
Will you uncover the mystery behind the house — or become part of it?

🩸 Gameplay Overview

Agyaat is a single-player first-person horror experience focused on exploration, atmosphere, and psychological tension. There are no weapons, only your courage and your instincts.

Move carefully through dark hallways, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover hidden clues that slowly reveal the history of the mansion and its tragic inhabitants. Every sound matters — every movement could wake something that should never be disturbed.

The game combines cinematic storytelling, realistic lighting, and immersive sound design to create an experience that feels genuinely alive — and relentlessly haunted.

⚙️ Key Features

🔦 First-Person Immersive Horror
Experience fear through the eyes of Acharya. Every flicker of light and creak of wood is felt up close.

🏚️ Exploration-Driven Storytelling

Uncover hidden notes, cursed artifacts, and spiritual clues that piece together the mansion’s horrifying past.

🧩 Environmental Puzzles

Solve realistic, story-connected puzzles that challenge both your mind and your nerve.

👁️ Dynamic AI Presence

Something unseen roams the halls — adapting to your movement, sound, and light usage.

🎧 3D Audio & Cinematic Atmosphere

Immersive sound design and ambient music create a deep sense of dread and realism.

💀 No Combat — Only Survival

There are no weapons or health bars. You survive through stealth, observation, and courage.

🌕 Realistic Visuals & Lighting

Crafted in Unity with dynamic lighting, volumetric fog, and detailed interiors to bring Ambika’s House to life.

🪔 Inspired by Indian Folklore

Rooted in myth and spirituality, Agyaat blends traditional horror with cultural mystery and emotional storytelling.

🌒 Can You Face the Unknown?

The truth is not always meant to be found.
Some houses remember their past — and in Ambika’s House, the past remembers you.

data.short_description: Agyaat is a first-person single-player horror game where you play as Acharya, drawn into the haunted depths of Ambika’s House to uncover a dark truth buried in Indian folklore. Explore, survive, and piece together the mansion’s twisted past — but beware, the house remembers every step you take.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains horror elements, blood, and disturbing imagery. It includes scenes of fear, psychological tension, and supernatural themes that may be unsettling for some players. There are no depictions of sexual content or self-harm. Viewer discretion is advised.
